subject: SIG kickoff prep & evidence gaps (post-demo)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>, Samantha Green <samantha.green@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Quick recap + SIG kickoff ask

Hi Samantha — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and suggested next steps from the demo so we can get your security intake moving: 

- What we heard: Helix Health is evaluating a hosted inference integration for clinical note summarization and claims routing. Primary requirements noted were HIPAA controls, SOC 2 Type II evidence, and EU residency for certain datasets.
- Immediate ask: can you confirm whether your procurement team would prefer a SIG Lite (CAIQ subset) or the full SIG questionnaire? That will determine the prefill strategy.
- Docs we can provide up front: SOC 2 summary, network diagram, data flow doc, and a short prefill guide (attached).

Proposed timeline (flexible):
1) Confirm questionnaire type and target stakeholders — this week
2) Kickoff call to align owners & timeline — next week
3) Prefill + evidence handoff — 1–2 week window after kickoff

Attachments: redwood-sig-intro.pdf (intro packet + sample answers)

Next step: Samantha, could you confirm preferred questionnaire type and whether you need our SOC 2 Type II report or a SOC 2 summary first? Also who from your InfoSec/Procurement should be on the kickoff?

Thanks,
Ben

--

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + SIG kickoff ask

Thanks Ben — looping in a couple quick technical clarifying questions so the SIG prefill is tuned and we don't ask for unnecessary evidence on the first pass. Samantha, quick Qs from our side: 

1) Questionnaire preference: if you answer "SIG (full)" are you actually expecting the full 300+ question bundle, or would you accept a SIG Lite / CAIQ matrix for initial procurement?
2) SOC 2: do you require us to share the full Type II report under NDA, or is a SOC 2 bridge letter + summary sufficient for initial review?
3) Data residency: which environments (prod/test) must stay in EU/US? Any restrictions on cross-border backups?
4) Encryption at rest: do you need KMS/HSM key attestations or just high-level design and algorithm descriptions?

If you have a preferred kickoff agenda, please share — we'll draft an internal owner list. Proposed owners from our side: Ben (commercial), Lukas (technical lead), Soojin (security/compliance).

On the timeline: if you want the full SIG, plan for a 2–3 week evidence collection; SIG Lite/CAIQ can often be handled in under a week with a focused prefill.

Appended is Ben's packet for reference.

Cheers,
Lukas

--

From: Samantha Green <samantha.green@helixhealth.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@helixhealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + SIG kickoff ask

Hi Lukas / Ben — thanks. Quick answers from our procurement/security side: 

1) We prefer starting with the full SIG, but for procurement velocity we'll accept a SIG Lite prefill first and then request the full matrix for legal review. 
2) SOC 2: procurement wants the SOC 2 Type II report but will accept it under NDA for the first pass. Please send your standard NDA or a copy of the report behind our SFTP link (we can set up).
3) Data residency: production PHI must remain in the US for now. EU residency will be required for EU patients later — we'll scope that in a follow-up phase. No cross-border backups for PHI.
4) Encryption: high-level design + KMS provider is sufficient for kickoff; we will request KMS attestations if things progress.

Kickoff attendees from Helix: Samantha Green (InfoSec lead), Tom Rivera (Procurement), and our cloud security engineer (TBD). Preferred kickoff window: week of Nov 8 — mornings PST.

I've attached our security contact spreadsheet; it lists the people to include and the procurement intake form we use.

Attachments: Helix_Security_Contacts.xlsx

Thanks,
Samantha

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + SIG kickoff ask — proposed kickoff + prefill checklist

Hi Samantha — great, thanks for the quick answers and the contact sheet. I'll own the SIG coordination from Redwood's security side. Proposed next steps and a short kickoff agenda below.

Prefill checklist (items we'll prepare before kickoff):
- Completed SIG Lite prefill (answers + references) — LU1
- SOC 2 Type II (redacted) available under NDA; I'll send our NDA and instructions for a secure transfer
- High-level network & encryption diagrams + list of KMS provider(s)
- Data flow doc showing PHI boundaries and retention windows
- List of sub-processors and regions of operation

Kickoff agenda (30–45m):
1) Introductions & scope (10m) — confirm systems in scope and data residency constraints
2) Questionnaire approach (5m) — agree Lite first vs. full SIG timeline
3) Evidence handoff plan (10m) — who owns each doc, transfer mechanism (SFTP/Drive), expected deadlines
4) Questions & blockers (10–20m)

Proposed kickoff times (mornings PST):
- Tuesday Nov 9, 9:30–10:15am
- Wednesday Nov 10, 10:00–10:45am

If either of those work for your team we'll send a calendar invite and a HubSpot deal update (HW-4932). I'll attach a short evidence template (SOC2-external-request-template.docx) that lists the redactions/filters we expect for the report.

Olive branch: to speed procurement, we recommend starting with the SIG Lite prefill + SOC2 summary while legal prepares for the full report exchange. We'll map the remaining SIG questions to owners during kickoff so the full SIG doesn't stall.

Action items for Helix: confirm kickoff time and identify the cloud security engineer for the invite.

Thanks,
Soojin
